finance.scopeNote: TripOS maintains two separate group-account ledgers. The historical six-person pool remains closed and auditable; the active eight-person account has its own cash, charges and end-of-trip settlement records. Active cash on hand is fully spendable during the trip, while any difference between book cash and a physical count is retained as an explicit audit variance rather than fabricated as an expense. Nishit and Het remain ₹500 outstanding in the active account. Jugal's old-account history is ₹1,500 + ₹1,000 + later ₹500 replacement = ₹3,000 cash; his former ₹100 auto credit is removed because he was reimbursed from old-pool cash.

interAccountLinks.note: The old six-person pool physically paid ₹200 for one taxi belonging to the active eight-person account. Old pool carries a ₹200 receivable and active pool carries a matching trip-end payable. This liability is tracked but does not reduce current active-group spendable cash.

memberCoveragePolicies.note: The current known Milan → Vyas liability remains ₹3,778.75 for costs Vyas already fronted. Milan's new ₹500 second-round active-group contribution was recorded as paid directly by Milan, so it is not a new Devgna advance and does not increase this liability. Shared active-group expenses funded from group cash, including the ₹2,430 dinner and latest ₹600 taxi, must not be added again as separate Milan debt.

groupFundPatch.note: Corrected old-account history: Jugal's Sep 14 morning ₹500 was never received; his settlement was ₹1,000 rather than ₹900; and the ₹100 group auto he initially paid was reimbursed from old-pool cash, so it is not a contribution credit. Before his later replacement payment, old-pool cash received is therefore ₹17,000 and confirmed non-audit cash outflows are ₹11,838, still projecting ₹5,162; after the preserved ₹462 historical audit variance, the corrected historical checkpoint remains ₹4,700. The old pool then paid ₹200 for the active-group taxi, leaving ₹4,500. Jugal's later ₹500 old-pool payment replaces the never-received morning ₹500, so expected current cash becomes ₹5,000. Latest physical count remains ₹4,500, leaving a separate current unexplained variance of −₹500. The ₹200 active-pool receivable makes observed economic balance ₹4,700 and expected economic balance ₹5,200.

contributions.note: ₹500 of Jugal's ₹1,000 handover was placed into the old six-person account as the replacement for his Sep 14 morning ₹500 that was never actually received.
